description: This file contains utility functions for handling Go types, including retrieving members by JSON name, checking if a type is nilable, converting types to their native form, and checking if types are directly comparable. It is part of the Kubernetes code generator tools.

methods.name: GetMemberByJSON
methods.description: Returns the child member of the type that has the specified JSON name, or nil if not found.

methods.name: IsNilableType
methods.description: Determines if the given type can be compared to nil.

methods.name: NativeType
methods.description: Returns the underlying Go native type, removing typedefs and handling pointers.

methods.name: NonPointer
methods.description: Returns the value type of a possibly pointer type.

methods.name: IsDirectComparable
methods.description: Checks if the type can be safely compared using '==', excluding pointers.
